q40_py_note: q40_py is Q40 re-expressed in Python (Q40-R with reliability off and only SUPPORTED records). It equals the frozen SQL within its 2-decimal rounding on clean data (test_q40r_with_reliability_off_equals_frozen_q40_on_real_data) and is used because the SQL cannot run on in-memory perturbed data.

perturbation_semantics.p: fraction of items affected (evidence items, records or candidates, see research/phase5/perturb.py); low_reliability: reliability scaled by (1-p); mixed_quality level L applies missing(L/2), timestamps(L/2), low_reliability(L/2), duplicate(L/2), invalidation(L/4)

sensitivity.weight_note: each weight scaled by the factor, others renormalised to sum 1 (one-at-a-time)
